title: How to download all course materials

cues.en: The purpose of this video is to show you how to get all of the code that you will need for this course.
cues.zh: 這段影片要示範如何取得這門課需要的所有程式碼。

cues.en: All the code for the course is on my GitHub in a repository called Master Math by coding in Python, same name as the course.
cues.zh: 課程全部程式碼都放在我的 GitHub，repo 叫 Master Math by Coding in Python，和課程同名。

cues.en: There is a direct link to this repo in the resources for this video.
cues.zh: 這段影片的資源裡，有直接連到 repo 的連結。

cues.en: Or you can go directly to the URL, or you can just google it and you will find it.
cues.zh: 你也能直接輸入網址，或用 Google 搜尋，就能找到。

cues.en: You can see that there are all these folders.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到很多資料夾。

cues.en: These folders correspond to the section titles of the course.
cues.zh: 這些資料夾對應到課程各章的名稱。

cues.en: So there is a section coming up on arithmetic.
cues.zh: 例如，接下來有算術章節。

cues.en: So we can look inside this folder.
cues.zh: 我們點進這個資料夾，

cues.en: We can see the organization.
cues.zh: 看看裡面的組織方式。

cues.en: Let me zoom out a little bit the organization of the file name.
cues.zh: 我稍微縮小一下，看看檔名怎麼安排。

cues.en: So it's the title of the course the title of the section.
cues.zh: 先是課程名稱，再來是章節名稱。

cues.en: This is the section for arithmetic.
cues.zh: 這裡是算術章節。

cues.en: And then a brief title of the corresponding to the title and the main topic of that video.
cues.zh: 接著是一個簡短的名稱，對應該段影片的標題和主要主題。

cues.en: So I hope those all make sense.
cues.zh: 希望這些命名都很清楚。

cues.en: So for example we can click on this ipynb file.
cues.zh: 例如可以點這個 .ipynb 檔。

cues.en: This is IPython notebook file.
cues.zh: 這是 IPython Notebook 檔案。

cues.en: We click on this.
cues.zh: 點開它，

cues.en: You can see this is all of the code that we will that I will cover in this particular lecture.
cues.zh: 就能看到這堂課會講解的所有程式碼。

cues.en: So this is a relatively short lecture.
cues.zh: 這堂課比較短，

cues.en: Some are a little bit shorter.
cues.zh: 有些還會再短一點，

cues.en: Some are a little bit longer.
cues.zh: 有些會長一點。

cues.en: Most of them have exercises.
cues.zh: 大多數都有練習。

cues.en: Now you do not actually need to look through all of this code because in fact I encourage you to code along with me.
cues.zh: 其實不必把這些程式碼全部看過，因為我鼓勵你跟著我一起寫。

cues.en: So in general, I recommend coding along with me in the videos.
cues.zh: 一般而言，我建議看影片時跟著自己寫程式。

cues.en: But if you want all of the code that I am going to show in the video, it's all here.
cues.zh: 不過，如果想取得影片會示範的所有程式碼，都在這裡，

cues.en: It's available for you.
cues.zh: 隨時可以使用。

cues.en: Now.
cues.zh: 那麼，

cues.en: If you are following along in Google Colab, you can just press this button, click this button.
cues.zh: 如果你用 Google Colab 跟課，只要按這個按鈕。

cues.en: I'm going to open it in a new tab.
cues.zh: 我把它開在新分頁。

cues.en: And that will directly open the file in Google Colab.
cues.zh: 這樣就會直接用 Google Colab 開啟檔案。

cues.en: And if you sign in to your Google account here, you can immediately start running this code online.
cues.zh: 如果在這裡登入 Google 帳號，就能立刻在線上執行程式。

cues.en: If you are running all of this code locally on your machine through Anaconda, then what you want to do is download all of these files.
cues.zh: 如果你透過 Anaconda 在本機電腦執行，就要下載這些檔案。

cues.en: Now it's really tedious to download every single file individually.
cues.zh: 逐一下載每個檔案很麻煩，

cues.en: I do not recommend doing that.
cues.zh: 我不建議這樣做。

cues.en: So instead what you want to do is download all the files at the same time from GitHub.
cues.zh: 應該從 GitHub 一次下載全部檔案。

cues.en: Now if you are familiar with GitHub, if you're comfortable with GitHub, you can clone this repository locally.
cues.zh: 如果熟悉 GitHub，也可以把這個 repo clone 到本機。

cues.en: If you have no idea what that means, then don't worry about it.
cues.zh: 如果完全不知道那是什麼意思，也不用擔心。

cues.en: You do not need to log in or sign up, or pay money or register or do anything like that.
cues.zh: 不必登入、註冊、付費，或做其他類似的事。

cues.en: You will look and see this button over here.
cues.zh: 你可以看這裡的按鈕，

cues.en: There's a green button that says code.
cues.zh: 有一個綠色的 Code 按鈕。

cues.en: You click on that and then the last option down here is download zip.
cues.zh: 點開，最下面的選項就是 Download ZIP。

cues.en: This is going to download all of these folders, all of the files absolutely everything you need for this course in one zip file.
cues.zh: 這會把所有資料夾、所有檔案，也就是上課需要的一切，全部放在一個 ZIP 裡下載。

cues.en: It will download it locally onto your computer as a zip.
cues.zh: 它會以 ZIP 的形式下載到本機電腦。

cues.en: And then you just need to unpack that zip file.
cues.zh: 接著只要解壓縮，

cues.en: And then you have all of the code files for this course.
cues.zh: 就有這門課全部的程式碼檔案了。
